promptUsed: A still from a surreal late-1980s Japanese computer-graphics art film: airbrushed, ray-traced, soft film grain, saturated colour. A vast causeway floats on a calm dark sea. Its floor is a tight grid of small pale aqua-white glossy tiles with thin dark grout lines and tiny sparkling highlights, smooth and orderly, never coloured glass. A narrow channel of mirror-black water with a twisting glass ribbon stair runs north toward a far platform on the horizon. A raised tiled plinth holds a shallow reflecting pool and a tall narrow tower clad in a blue glass-tile grid. A colossal slab of luminous blue glass like frozen water-light, streaked vertically with white, carries a cantilevered roof slab with a terracotta-tile underside. Farther east stands a dark indigo slab whose face is a field of stars. Two gnarled trees with twisted trunks and dense crowns of thousands of tiny pixel-like dark-green leaves with yellow-green speckles: a windswept bent tree at the causeway's western edge and a smaller tree on the plinth beside the tower. Far to the south, two short glass pillars form a gate. Lighting: the sun sits on the northern horizon, just west of north, inside a blazing red-orange haze band, and a frozen lightning bolt strikes the far northern platform. Northern sky ultramarine with torn clouds glowing molten orange and gold; eastern and western skies cobalt with orange-lit cloud undersides; the southern sky, away from the sun, is deep indigo-violet with the first stars and no sun. No people, no text.
